user.title: Sekurak
user.description: Pick the phone running the Sekurak app (Companion App notify service).

abort.already_configured: This phone is already set up.

dodaj.title: Add sensor
dodaj.description: Pick an entity, type a name (shown on the phone), choose what it triggers. Inverted = alarm on off/closed instead of on/open.

ustawienia.title: Settings
ustawienia.description:
Arming: Alarm-type sensors only work while this entity is armed (armed_* or on), after the exit delay. Empty = always. Flood and other types always work.

The silence webhook is one-time (random ID per alarm, max 15 min). Pattern: {webhook_url}

data.external_url: HA external address, as in the Companion App
data.secret: Secret (same as in the app, empty = none)
